_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_as_of: 2026-08-05 · SkyMail — the MAP Users tab can now show which colleges have NO student-facing CPL contact, and who to route each one to.
_status: A student asking one of 25 colleges for CPL through MAP was reaching nobody: MAP sends those requests to the college's Primary Contact email, and those 25 had none on file — 24 of them with a live landing page. The MAP Users tab now has a 'No student contact' filter listing exactly those colleges, with a proposed person for each. Every proposal is someone the COLLEGE already designated in MAP (CPL Coordinator, CPL Assistant, CPL Counselor, Articulation Officer...), because colleges are locally governed and we route to their people rather than choosing new ones — that resolves 17 of the 25. The other 8 need a human to name someone; Jessica already supplied contacts for two of them. Ashley and Jessica are in the session and their MAP knowledge is what the remaining work needs.

items.text: 📇 MAP USERS — 6 colleges need your eye. Siskiyous, Cosumnes River, Feather River, Hartnell, NOCE and Calbright have no CPL contact in MAP, so I looked up the counseling inbox each college publishes on its own website. Those are a starting point, not a MAP designation — the tab shows the source link next to each one. Gavilan needed a human to get right, so at least one of these six probably does too. Tell me the correct person and I'll record it with your name on it.

⚠ THE HEADLINE: 25 of 123 colleges have no Primary Contact email — the address MAP sends student CPL requests to. 24 of them have a live landing page, so a student asking those colleges today reaches nobody. Open MAP Users → '⚠ No student contact' (needs sign-in). 17 have a proposed person drawn from their own MAP designations; the tab drafts the email telling the college who we routed them to.

🙋 8 colleges have nobody to propose. 5 have only a VPAA or CEO on file — I deliberately did NOT route student requests to a vice president, since that's the college's call. 3 (Calbright Credit, North Orange Continuing Ed Credit, San Diego CCE Credit) have zero MAP users at all — that's the same standalone continuing-ed onboarding gap the Noncredit tab flagged, not a contact problem.

Build Jessica's cut as a live tab filter: the 71 colleges with no CPL Assistant, with the best fallback user (Primary Contact first, then the cascade). It was delivered as a chat table, which goes stale against the monthly sync. The lens plumbing already exists — it's a sibling of the gap lens.

🔗 Still open since Session 87: the exact MAP URL you want the 'update your contacts' link to point at. The draft emails currently link each college's MAP CPL dashboard. One-line change once you send it.

❓ 6 items are waiting on you (filter: 'Needs Input'). The one that unlocks the most: HOW MANY colleges and high-school partners are on the incumbent articulation system? It sizes the largest-volume lane in the whole analysis and nothing in our repos carries it. Also open: is MAP's high-school role decided or aspirational, landing-page build dates, the CDCR back-catalog, Calbright's FTES (needs Malone), and where the '44 non-CCC dental programs' figure came from.

⭐ THE BIG FINDING: 49 statewide exhibits are published across 252 college-slots with ZERO students served — only 30 of 84 statewide exhibits have ever converted a single unit. CompTIA Linux+ is live at 16 colleges and has never produced an award. The faculty work is DONE on all of these; what's missing is outreach. Cheapest volume available anywhere in CPL. The list is live in the tab and refreshes itself.

⚠ NOCE, San Diego College of Continuing Education, Mt. SAC Noncredit and Calbright appear on ZERO of MAP's 1,987 credential titles — while ~48 entries already name a specific high school. The gap isn't permission or capability; nobody has done the data entry. Highest value-for-effort item in the whole workstream.

QUEUED (Sam's idea): a simple ADMINISTRATOR opt-in button on the college rows (VPAA/VPSS/CEO) — the participation-request qual. Recommended design (full write-up in docs/cpl_funding_handoff.md): don't verify against our stale admin roster — capture the current admin AT opt-in time (name/title/email form → pending cpl_optin row) and let the CO confirm in a review lane (reuse the merge-confirm pattern), then wire it into baselineGate. v2 = a magic-link email to a college-domain address for self-service. Build v1 next.

🆕 The ESL packaging DRY-RUN is ready to eyeball (kb/esl_package_out/2026-07-15/esl_package_report.md + the visual). It maps all 2,364 ESL courses → Beginning/Intermediate/Advanced + carve-outs. Two things worth your look before it applies: (1) confirm the 22 'Transfer-level ESL' candidates (college-composition courses — no transferable flag in the data, so I held them out rather than fold them); (2) the ~629 no-level courses folded to Beginning as the safe under-claim. Green-light → it applies.

Carpentry folds still in the ⇒ Merge confirms lane: Rigging + Blueprint Reading-Residential rows + a few key collisions — ✓ Confirm merge (or rename apart) per row. Plus 4 still-ambiguous CTCNC rows (CARP 707/710/713 + Work Experience) that carry TWO credit recs each — pick the right title in-cell.

⚠️ Two errors are still in the Sept-2026 BOG amendment workbook itself — the copy heading to the Board. Its grand total says $74,000,000 but double-counts the $8,959,692 project slice (the real figure is $71,000,000), and its 'Max Award $665,971' is a typo for $665,791 computed over 115 colleges while its average uses 119. Our tab already shows the corrected numbers.
